The vendor directly providing **Dashlane** at **dashlane.com** is **Dashlane, Inc.** (operating through its entities **Dashlane USA, Inc.** and **Dashlane SAS**).

### Provider Statement & Evidence
According to the official **Dashlane Terms of Service** (Section 1(a), *Introduction*) at `dashlane.com`:
> *"Dashlane, Inc. and its affiliates (“Dashlane”, or “we” and its derivatives) operate www.dashlane.com (together with any subdomains, the “Site”) and provide our users (each user, “you”) with mobile and web applications and web extensions... The Services are provided by either Dashlane USA, Inc. a Delaware corporation with offices at 44 West 18th Street, New York, NY 10011 USA, or Dashlane SAS, a French company with offices at 21 Rue Pierre Picard, 75018 Paris, as indicated on the payment record for your subscription."*
